The supply chain's most important element in its supply is distributor or supplier. The location, transportation method, cost and quality plays a significant role. The project discusses a method to data mapping, visualization and applying machine learning techniques in order to identify optimum location in a neighborhood in Scarborough of Toronto for a groceries contractor.
